title: App does not open but shows in library
author: BlastOffProductions
body:
### Describe the feature or issue.

Hi there, I have an old copy of the game Lion Pride that i'm using, and sadly it doesn't run on the emulator. It shows up in the library but when I open it, it quickly closes. Any ideas of what the issue may be? Thanks!

comments.body: The vast majority of iOS games do not currently work in touchHLE, and we don't want issues created for non-working games because then we'd be overwhelmed by them. Sorry.
